_Be the last Survivr standing._



h1. FAQ

What is Surviv.io? A fast-paced, free-to-play 2D battle royale where up to 80 players compete to be the last survivor on a shrinking island.

How do you play? You spawn with nothing and search buildings and crates for weapons, armor, and supplies. The safe zone shrinks, forcing players together until one remains. Move: W, A, S, D. Aim: mouse. Left-click to attack. Right-click to emote.

Does Surviv.io have multiplayer modes? Yes — Solo, Duos, Squads, and rotating limited-time modes.

What platforms can I play on? Play directly in your web browser on Kongregate.

Is Surviv.io free to play? Yes, completely free.
